annotations.description: Node {{ $labels.node }} in cluster {{ $labels.cluster }} reports NVIDIA GPU capacity but zero or absent allocatable GPUs. Check host nvidia-smi for a loaded-driver/installed-library mismatch. Check the NVIDIA device-plugin logs and GPU health. If a reboot is necessary, plan it with Ceph safety checks before any host restart.
annotations.summary: NVIDIA GPU capacity has no allocatable GPUs.
